title: Past simple of 'to be' - Review with more contexts

options.answer: They was at the park yesterday.
He were a great student.
We were very happy with the results.

explanation.en: The past simple of 'to be' is 'was' for singular subjects (I, he, she, it) and 'were' for plural subjects (we, you, they). The correct sentence uses 'were' with the plural subject 'we'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее простое время 'to be' — это 'was' для единственного числа (I, he, she, it) и 'were' для множественного числа (we, you, they). Правильное предложение использует 'were' с подлежащим множественного числа 'we'.
explanation.uz: 'To be' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli birlik subyektlar uchun 'was' (I, he, she, it) va ko'plik subyektlar uchun 'were' (we, you, they). To'g'ri gap 'we' ko'plik subyekti bilan 'were' shaklini ishlatadi.
